questions.stem: A student wants to make copper sulfate crystals. Which starting materials should they use?

options.text: Copper oxide and dilute sulfuric acid

questions.explanation: Copper oxide reacted with dilute sulfuric acid produces copper sulfate. CuO + H₂SO₄ → CuSO₄ + H₂O. Copper metal cannot be used because it is below hydrogen in the reactivity series and does not react with dilute acids.
